_description: Sprint 10b (ADR-0033), plan §A.1/§C.2, §E.9 item 2. Consolidates the union of TopicLexicon::ANCHORS topics into one canonical question per topic (the question-side of the SAME shared lexicon the precedence re-rank uses chunk-side) — no such consolidated list existed before this sprint (Sprint7cReferenceFactAnswerTest.php carries only 'periodo de prueba' inline). No code change to TopicLexicon in this sprint (D1: no real gap found); this file exists so the full anchor set has a re-runnable regression fixture. Metric: every question anchors to the SAME topic_key it does today (TopicLexicon::matchTopicKeys), unchanged by anything else this sprint touches. Harness: Sprint10bInvariantTest.php-adjacent — a direct unit check against TopicLexicon::matchTopicKeys(), not a full chat-loop run (no LLM/DB needed; ReferenceFactRouter::detectTopic() additionally requires a verified fact row to actually route, which is a fixture concern, not a lexicon one).

Listed for lexicon completeness, not as a reachable reference-fact path.
